rows.note: Use 辦公室 as the all-purpose term for a physical office, especially the room or workplace.

example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 baan6 gung1 sat1 zou6 gan2 je5

rows.note: Use 寫字樓 when you mean an office building or commercial office premises rather than a particular room.

example.english: That office building has many companies.
example.traditional: 嗰棟寫字樓有好多公司。
example.jyutping: go2 dung6 se2 zi6 lau4 jau5 hou2 do1 gung1 si1

rows.note: Use 部門 when “office” means an administrative department such as a public-relations department.

example.english: The public-relations office needs to hold a meeting today.
example.jyutping: gung1 gwaan1 bou6 mun4 gam1 jat6 jiu3 hoi1 wui2
